items.heading: Before Picking One, IT Helps
items.text: Before picking one, it helps to see all four laid out the same way: what you are actually selling, who it fits, and the trade-off nobody puts on the landing page.

items.heading: This Is What Most People
items.text: This is what most people mean when they say freelancing: writing, design, development, marketing, consulting, or any deliverable a client pays for one project at a time. It is the model with the shortest path to your first payment, because it only needs one client to say yes.

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: Tutoring pays fastest, since a single session with one student can generate income immediately, with rates for Indian tutors commonly ranging from roughly ₹300 to ₹2,000 per session depending on subject, level, and platform. Courses take longer to build and usually sell better once you already have some proof that people want the specific thing you are teaching, from prior tutoring sessions, client work, or an early audience, rather than being built purely on assumption.
